lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs₄Hf₂Ti₂F₁₂ (reduced formula Cs₂HfTiF₆) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 119), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral HfF₆ and TiF₆ environments, each with six fluorine neighbors, while Cs centers show a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 fluorine neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Hf- and Ti-centered octahedra, and face-sharing occurs between Cs and Hf polyhedra, as well as between Cs and Ti polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
